description: Toy translation (lib/ml/sequenceTasks.js translateExample, at most one adjective per noun): English-like source, French-like target where adjectives follow their noun.

training.optimizer: Adam, lr 0.01 then 0.003 for the last quarter, gradients clipped to norm 1
training.data: fresh random sentences of 1–3 clauses every batch (seed 1001)
training.loss: mean cross-entropy per target word, teacher forcing
training.rounding: weights rounded to 5 significant figures, then evaluated
